metadata.description: Rosetta - Software Engineering Accelerator providing AI agents with unified access to instructions, workflows, skills, and business context

plugins.name: rosetta
plugins.description: Rosetta for Cursor - Software Engineering Accelerator instruction set, workflows, and guardrails.

plugins.name: rosetta-light
plugins.description: Rosetta for Cursor - Software Engineering Accelerator instruction set, workflows, and guardrails. (lightweight profile: simpler workflows, smaller models)

plugins.name: core
plugins.description: Rosetta for Cursor - core set: composable skills, always-on rules, bootstrap and guardrail hooks; required by every other Rosetta plugin.

plugins.name: advanced
plugins.description: Rosetta for Cursor - advanced set: subagents, workflows, and orchestration automation. Requires the `core` plugin.

plugins.name: qe
plugins.description: Rosetta for Cursor - qe set: test automation and test generation. Requires the `core` and `advanced` plugins.

plugins.name: search
plugins.description: Rosetta for Cursor - search set: Solr and search engineering. Requires the `core` and `advanced` plugins.

plugins.name: modernization
plugins.description: Rosetta for Cursor - modernization set: conversion, modernization, and re-architecture. Requires the `core` and `advanced` plugins.
